runtime_preflight: recheck exact cached revisions and native chat templates before generation
no checkpoint replacement or added system prompt
save rendered native input, token ids, full output and stop reason
compare existing template hashes; disclose changes before inference
never start from this review draft; create separate frozen receipt after human review
primary_comparison: Per model paired semantic-fidelity transition K vs H on TRANSLATE; C/W/U counts by base context and family.
secondary_comparisons: target lexical meaning and event-state errors separately
same-condition independent EVENT_QA vs TRANSLATE four-way cross-task pattern
full translation omissions, invented information, language and format separately
scoring: Proposed semantic fact checklist; accept valid paraphrases; AI provisional, PI and independent review separate. Ambiguous content U is not W; no post-result changes to frozen scores.
inference_limits: 4 families and 8 correlated base contexts; 144 requests are not independent n
K/H changes tokenization, length, frequency and naturalness; not pure visual causality
P changes wording and length; not matched frequency or tokenization
two relation categories are different selected words, not a randomized relation manipulation
no Chinese-source or nonshared-language control; no homograph-specific or cross-language causal claim
question wording may supply cues; independent-task inconsistency is not knowledge within one trajectory
strong contexts and selected familiar concepts may yield ceiling; all correct is not absence of interference

review_sample.population: all 8 authored base contexts, 24 source variants, 48 user messages repeated across 3 checkpoints
review_sample.basis: 4 selected families x 2 event outcomes; 8 review groups show all three variants and the event question
review_sample.scope: user reads 8 groups and shared prompt templates; complete 48 user messages available in Excel
review_sample.not_covered: other lexical families, natural population, Chinese source controls, longer documents, internal activations

human_reference_status: AI draft references; no independent gold
branch_rules: Reliable K-to-H rescue across at least 2 families in at least 2 models is a candidate for a new independently sourced behavioral test; this screen is not significance, generality or a mechanism.
If K/H/P share similar event errors, prioritize evidence-use diagnosis and preserve the specific counterexamples.
If only P helps, keep a wording/explicitness explanation; do not call it character interference.
If correct throughout or mixed/sparse, report insufficient discrimination and review difficulty/materials before a separately preregistered next test.
If references/equivalence/scoring fail, stop causal interpretation and repair materials in a new version; retain outputs.

output_review.method: one output per base context; model and condition rotate deterministically over ordered B01..B08, TRANSLATE for odd ids and EVENT_QA for even ids
output_review.additional_review: all unresolved, model disagreements, K/H/P rescues and harms are listed separately; user reviews necessary cases before dependent follow-up

postrun_delivery: Excel complete 144 planned responses plus failures and review views
